note: v4 Phase 2A look check (2026-11-05, Nusrat; recording format changed 2026-11-07 to docs/look_check_v4.md, Anisha's look_check_v4.py): renders every candidate look in held Humanoid poses with the pan-tilt camera settings and writes them in her input format, so her tool runs the real models on them. An engineering check, not an evaluation: no threshold is set or changed from it. Read by Tools > Warehouse v4 > Look Check (Editor only); nothing in the v3 or v4 study scenes reads it.

why.format: docs/look_check_v4.md: names <look>__<COMMAND>__<distance_m>__<take>; a single frame is <name>.png + <name>.json, a sequence is a folder <name>/ with frame_000.png + frame_000.json ... ; the header is the bridge's frame_pan_tilt header (protocol 3) plus the person's own gesturing arm under 'arm' (POINT, WAIT, STOP). The take label starts with the arm (e.g. left_seq1), because the arm is not part of the name. folder_name holds the recordings only (the tool reads every subfolder as a sequence); the run's own files sit next to it.
why.distances_m: docs/look_check_v4.md: 2.0 m decides the verdict (the asking distance), 4.0 m is the secondary distance.
why.vertical_fov_deg: docs/look_check_v4.md: the default field of view (robot_unity_v4.json pan_tilt_camera.vertical_fov_deg). Camera size, height, clip planes and the level tilt come from robot_unity_v4.json through PanTiltCamera.ApplyCameraSettings, the code the robot uses.
why.sequence_frames: docs/look_check_v4.md: 1 s at 10 Hz, t = 0.0 to 1.0 s, 11 frames. The pose is held still for the whole second (rendered in Edit Mode, so the 11 frames are identical). time_s is left out of the header (there is no Unity Time.time in an Edit Mode render), so the tool uses its 10 Hz fallback.

commands_note: Pose design, declared before any model was run on these variants. Every arm direction is in the worker's body frame (the worker faces the camera): azimuth_front_deg turns the arm from straight out to the person's own side (0 = sideways in the image plane) toward the camera (90 = straight at it); elevation_deg is above (+) or below (-) horizontal. forearm_up: the direction is the upper arm's and the forearm is vertical (bent elbow), else the whole arm is straight. POINT: index finger extended along the arm, other fingers curled; seq1 sideways in the image plane and seq2 45 deg toward the front, as docs/look_check_v4.md asks. WAIT: forearm vertical, hand beside the head, index up, other fingers curled, palm toward the camera; seq1 is the Phase 2A pose (0.8 side + 0.3 front, 0.35 down). STOP: fingers up, palm toward the camera, the four fingers fanned by spread_deg per finger away from the middle finger; seq1 extended toward the robot (v3 GestureWorker STOP: front + 0.25 up + 0.2 side), seq2 bent. The other arm hangs relaxed. NONE (optional negative control, no arm label): both arms hang, mirrored, relaxed hands. Singles f1..f5 differ a little in arm direction, hand height and finger spread, as docs/look_check_v4.md recommends.

why.scene: Neutral grey floor and backdrop and one directional light, so the looks are compared under the same light; the warehouse background is not part of this check.
why.magenta_tolerance: A pixel counts as error-shader magenta when R and B are >= 255 - tolerance and G <= tolerance (8-bit).

hand.why: fist_curl_deg, fist_thumb_curl_deg and rest_outward are v3 GestureWorker's values (fingerCurlDeg, thumbCurlDeg, restOutward); relaxed values are pose design (a loosely open hand hanging), chosen before any model was run.

looks_note: Look ids are the <look> part of the recording names: a-z, 0-9 and single underscores (never '__', which separates the name's parts). VRoid looks: copy each .vrm into Assets/ThirdParty/VRoid/ (git-ignored) and add one entry like vrm_seed_san (kind prefab, asset = the .vrm path, family vrm, role candidate). Sunbox variants: the pack's preset .txt files are not used (the free pack has no preset loader, and the presets name items and hair styles of the paid pack); each variant is the free pack's own items named here. A look whose asset is not installed is reported as not_installed, never skipped silently.
